answer: Mechanism: divergent-trace oracle. Each agent periodically submits a signed execution trace over a challenge seeded by its prior trace root plus a public tundra beacon, encrypted with a per-agent cipher and tagged with a ferrous-housing timing fingerprint. Exact clones share priors and deterministic policies, so they produce identical trace roots under the same beacon; the verifier collapses duplicates into one identity. Evasion requires maintaining a distinct stateful lineage, timing noise, and calibration per identity—full per-agent compute, storage, and hardware cost.
